disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction from a locked period is deterministic retrieval, not judgment; it is merged into TS-01's automated pipeline. The locked-period gate (KB-03) survives as a structural property the engine cannot bypass, and a multi-adapter design (automated and governed manual-upload) preserves the extraction function identically for entities lacking full system integration, with a named reconciliation owner handling escalated breaks rather than routine human re-verification.

Loading the approved budget and latest forecast is versioned-artifact retrieval. It merges into TS-01, with the ambiguous 'latest forecast' question resolved once by a named owner as a documented comparator-version policy read at runtime, not re-decided every period or inferred by a model.

Price/volume/mix computation with FX isolation is formula-driven arithmetic once the inputs and methodology are fixed; it merges into TS-01. The decomposition methodology, FX rate source, and GL-to-driver mapping table are preserved as governed, versioned, disclosed parameters per KB-06, KB-07 and KB-08, so automation relocates the judgment to configuration time rather than eliminating it, and any change is surfaced rather than silently absorbed.

Applying numeric, pre-approved thresholds is mechanical pattern-matching and is restructured into an automated rules engine, satisfying VAR-R-08's survival requirement as an identifiable, auditable gate rather than hidden inside the computation engine. A mandatory-rationale override log and a named threshold-recalibration owner preserve accountability against base-effect staleness, and the engine's distinctness from the TS-05 reviewer satisfies VAR-R-04's actor separation structurally rather than incidentally.

Budget-holder accountability for explaining variances is substantive, not ceremonial, and survives, but the labor is inverted from composing to confirming, amending or rejecting a grounded, citation-constrained draft. The four-way disposition log (including a distinct unvalidated-escalated state) preserves the evidentiary trail KB-02 requires and prevents the step from silently degrading into rubber-stamping or into FP&A re-authoring commentary under deadline pressure.

Consolidating structured, already-validated variances and commentary into a draft report is template assembly with no independent judgment, and is absorbed into an automated assembly step. A substantive staleness/duplicate-text and schema-completeness check (not a naive non-null check) catches the specific failure mode of resubmitted prior-period commentary, with any flag escalated to the FP&A analyst rather than suppressed or waved through by a ceremonial human glance.

Review and challenge is the irreducible human-judgment core of the workflow and is retained without dilution, per VAR-R-07. It is strengthened, not merely preserved on paper, by giving the reviewer first-class visibility into upstream methodology, FX convention, comparator policy, override rationale and commentary disposition, because KB-02's faithful-representation standard is only satisfied if the reviewer can actually interrogate the basis for the numbers, not merely approve a polished narrative.

Distribution to management is mechanical publishing once a report is approved, and is merged into a deterministic, approval-gated publish step distinct from TS-05's human judgment. The gate requires an explicit, identity-stamped approval event rather than a timeout or inferred non-objection; audience-specific redaction is handled by declarative rules over tags captured upstream at TS-03, never by runtime model judgment, and no audience format may net or suppress the FX-effect line required visible under KB-08.

steps.actor: Automated ingestion-and-computation pipeline (deterministic), governed by a named FP&A configuration owner; named reconciliation owner handles escalated exceptions
steps.description: A deterministic pipeline, triggered on period-lock, extracts actuals from the locked period (via an automated system adapter for integrated entities, or a governed manual-upload adapter carrying identical lineage requirements for entities without system-level closed-period access), loads the approved budget version and the latest forecast per a documented comparator-version policy, and computes price, volume and mix variances against a versioned, disclosed decomposition methodology and entity-specific constant-currency FX source, isolating the FX effect as a distinct, non-netted line. The mapping table (GL movements to variance drivers), comparator-version policy, decomposition methodology, and FX rate source are governed configuration parameters, each logged and version-controlled, set once by a named owner and never inferred at runtime; the engine cannot draw actuals from an unlocked period. Extraction or computation breaks are escalated as a structured exception, carrying the estimated downstream variance impact, to a named reconciliation owner rather than resolved by silent default or routine human re-verification.
inputs: Governed mapping-table, comparator-version, methodology and FX-source configuration parameters
steps.name: Automated ingestion and variance computation pipeline
outputs: Variance dataset (full population, FX effect isolated as a distinct line)

steps.actor: Automated materiality rules engine (deterministic); override and recalibration authority held by a named FP&A role distinct from the TS-05 reviewer
steps.description: A deterministic rules engine applies the percentage and absolute materiality thresholds to the full variance dataset to select variances requiring explanation, retaining the complete unselected population as a retrievable dataset rather than discarding it, so that developing patterns below threshold remain reconstructable. Any override of the mechanical selection requires a mandatory structured rationale, actor identity and timestamp, written to an append-only log. Threshold parameters carry a named recalibration owner with a documented trigger (acquisition, divestiture, reorganisation or other structural P&L change); changes are proposed and edited through a logged, centrally-visible process even where local or regional teams hold proposal rights, so edit accessibility does not come at the cost of group-level consistency or an accountable single owner.
steps.name: Automated materiality thresholding with logged override

steps.actor: Budget holders (accountable), assisted by a grounded, citation-constrained drafting agent
steps.description: A grounded drafting agent pre-generates candidate variance explanations citing only specific structured inputs (decomposition figures, methodology label, known business events, prior-period commentary checked for staleness or duplication) and explicitly surfaces the comparator basis and methodology that produced the number being explained; where evidence is insufficient to support a claim, the agent exits to 'insufficient data' rather than inventing a narrative. The accountable budget holder records one of four structured outcomes for each item — accepted as drafted, amended, rejected and rewritten, or unvalidated/escalated (covering both non-response and the case where response is unavailable due to infrastructure constraints) — through either a full evidentiary interface or a low-bandwidth fallback channel that still preserves this four-way distinction and a minimal evidentiary basis. Commentary referencing another business unit or an individual is structurally tagged here for downstream audience-based redaction.
steps.name: Grounded draft-then-validate budget holder commentary
outputs: Budget holder commentary with disposition tag (accepted / amended / rejected-rewritten / unvalidated-escalated)

steps.actor: Automated report-assembly pipeline (deterministic), escalating to FP&A analyst on flagged exceptions
steps.description: Deterministic template assembly consolidates the selected variances and validated commentary into a draft variance report, running a schema-completeness check and a staleness/duplicate-text check against prior-period commentary. Any missing commentary, schema violation, or detected staleness blocks progression and is escalated to the FP&A analyst as a production-support exception; no ceremonial human 'quick check' with no decision authority is introduced in place of, or alongside, the machine checks.
steps.name: Automated report assembly and integrity checks

steps.actor: FP&A manager (structurally distinct role from the TS-02 selection function)
steps.description: The FP&A manager reviews and challenges the draft report with full visibility into the upstream methodology, FX rate convention, comparator-version policy, mapping-table version, any materiality override and its logged rationale, and the accepted/amended/rejected-rewritten/unvalidated disposition of every item of commentary, testing whether explanations are internally consistent across business units, non-recurring without basis, and faithfully representative given what is known of the business. An optional advisory, no-write-authority consistency-check agent may flag candidate cross-report contradictions or suspiciously recurring text for the reviewer's attention; its flags and any dismissals are logged and periodically reviewed, and it cannot approve, reject or modify the report. The manager's explicit, identity-stamped approval is required before the report may proceed to distribution; no timeout or inferred non-objection suffices.
inputs: Upstream configuration parameters (methodology, FX source, comparator policy, mapping-table version)
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.actor: Automated distribution pipeline (deterministic), triggered strictly by TS-05's approval event
steps.description: On receipt of TS-05's explicit, identity-stamped approval event, a deterministic publish action renders and pushes audience-specific formats (for example a board-pack summary and a detailed business-unit pack) from a declarative, named-owner-configured mapping of report sections to audience, applying redaction based on the sensitivity tags captured at TS-03 rather than any runtime model judgment on disclosure. Rendered formats avoid requiring premium platform licensing for recipients without full access. No audience-tailored format may net or omit the isolated FX-effect line or otherwise suppress a required disclosure for presentational simplicity; publication never fires on a timeout or an absence of objection.
steps.name: Approval-gated automated distribution
